research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Teladoc Health is developing systems for autonomous patient monitoring in a telehealth system and automatic detection of patient availability in a telehealth system, using in room devices, cameras, and object detection to manage remote consultation interfaces. It is also creating automated health condition scoring in telehealth encounters using audio and video streams with multiple AI detectors to assess clinical status. Together these efforts focus on remote monitoring, encounter triage, and workflow optimization in virtual care.

overview_description.description: Teladoc is a mission-driven organization, modernizing how people access and experience healthcare with a focus on high quality, lower costs, and improved outcomes around the world. The company’s award-winning, integrated clinical solutions are inclusive of telehealth, expert medical opinions, AI and analytics, and licensable platform services. With more than 2,000 employees, the organization delivers care in 125 countries and in more than 20 languages, partnering with employers, hospitals and health systems, and insurers to transform care delivery.
